title: From Imperfective Paradox to Moorean Absurdity: Single-Chain Reasoning Lock-In and Multi-Candidate Verbalization Across Aspectual and Pragmatic Ambiguity
abstract: arXiv:2611.22188v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Natural language entailment and coherence judgments often depend on whether an event merely occurred, reached a telic culmination, satisfied a plan, or was evaluated under multiple pragmatic standards. We test observable consequences of the single-chain premature lock-in hypothesis across four preregistered, sealed formal experiments on Qwen3-8B-Q8_0 (16,640 formal units, temperature=0.0): 15 of 16 hypothesis slots retain confirmatory status (12 rejecting H0 under within-experiment Holm control at alpha_fam=0.05; E3_H3 demoted to descriptive status). In Experiment 1, Direct-CoT vs. MCU differs by 25.00 pp on telic high-confidence completion (Holm p=1.31239e-05), while NLI-CoT collapses by -91.25 pp on uninterrupted atelic items (Holm p=1.81805e-21). Multi-Candidate Verbalization (MCV) elicits K=5 weighted estimates in one call, separating the prompt from unweighted (MCU) and self-weighted (MCW) readouts. Mandarin (E2) and English (E3)

translated_title: 从未完成体悖论到摩尔式荒谬：体貌与语用歧义下的单链推理锁定与多候选言语化
translated_abstract: 自然语言的蕴含与连贯性判断往往取决于一个事件是否仅仅发生了、是否达成了终结性的完成点、是否满足了某个计划，抑或是在多种语用标准下被评估。我们通过四项预注册、密封形式的实验（在 Qwen3-8B-Q8_0 模型上进行，共 16,640 个形式单元，temperature=0.0）检验了“单链过早锁定假说”的可观察结果：16 个假设槽位中有 15 个保持验证性地位（其中 12 个在实验内 Holm 校正下于 alpha_fam=0.05 水平拒绝 H0；E3_H3 降级为描述性地位）。在实验 1 中，Direct-CoT 与 MCU 在终结性高置信度完成上相差 25.00 个百分点（Holm p=1.31239e-05），而 NLI-CoT 在无中断的非终结性项目上崩溃了 -91.25 个百分点（Holm p=1.81805e-21）。多候选言语化（MCV）在单次调用中引出 K=5 个加权估计，将提示与未加权（MCU）和自加权（MCW）读出方式分离。普通话（实验 2）与英语（实验 3）……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文通过四项预注册的形式化实验证实了大语言模型在体貌与语用歧义推理中存在“单链过早锁定”现象，并提出多候选言语化（MCV）方法，在单次调用中生成多个加权候选估计以缓解该锁定问题。
en_tdlr: Through four preregistered formal experiments, this paper confirms the "single-chain premature lock-in" phenomenon in LLM reasoning under aspectual and pragmatic ambiguity, and proposes Multi-Candidate Verbalization (MCV), which elicits multiple weighted candidate estimates in a single call to mitigate this lock-in effect.
